terra.problem: Saying that fruit was never the disciples’ job misstates Jesus’ teaching: He appointed them to go and bear lasting fruit, though they can do so only by remaining in Him (verses 4–5, 16).

The pruning of fruitful branches is intended to make them more fruitful, but Jesus also says the Father cuts off branches that bear no fruit. Saying the whole point of both cutting and pruning is a bigger harvest blurs that warning.
